title: Metsä Board upgrades its coated white-top kraftliner production chain
summary: The Finnish packaging board manufacturer has launched a project to modernise the finishing operations at its Kemi mill. Metsä Board will therefore modernize the winder of the factory's cardboard machine. The operations must be implemented during the annual maintenance shutdown scheduled for October-November 2026.
